context.industry_note: Show service continuity, food-industry garment control and hygiene-related performance. Prioritize water use/savings and washed-kg efficiency. Highlight turnaround, service-request-free days and delivery performance.

kpis.label: Water saving vs baseline
kpis.formula_text: washed_kg x baseline water x s - allocated water

kpis.label: Active wearers
kpis.formula_text: last month: sum over sites of max over products of active_wearers

kpis.label: On-time delivery rate
kpis.formula_text: 1 - count(LATE cycles) / count(cycles)

kpis.label: Service requests per 100 wearers

kpis.label: Product footprint of postponed replacements

kpis.label: Sites

kpis.label: Repairs completed
kpis.formula_text: sum of repair_count

kpis.label: Recycling rate

kpis.label: Washed textile
kpis.formula_text: sum of washed_kg

kpis.label: Average cycle time

kpis.label: Service requests

kpis.label: Allocated process energy

observations.title: High washing intensity at NorthStar Kraków
observations.finding: NorthStar Kraków washes 67.0 kg per wearer against a peer median of 48.8 kg (z = 2.2).
observations.action: Check change frequency against hygiene needs.

observations.title: Estimated savings versus the baseline
observations.finding: Against the Outsourced local laundry baseline the account saves about 1,406.6 m3 water (range 691.2 to 2,122.1) and 255.1 tonnes CO2e (range 205.7 to 304.4).
observations.action: Use the range, and confirm the baseline with the customer.

observations.title: High service-request rate at NorthStar Gdańsk
observations.finding: NorthStar Gdańsk logs 17.1 service requests per 100 wearers, 3.0 times the peer median (5.6) (z = 2.9).
observations.action: Break the requests down by type and agree a target.

observations.title: Lowest on-time delivery at NorthStar Pori
observations.finding: NorthStar Pori delivers 97.2% of cycles on time against a peer median of 98.3% (z = -2.2).
observations.action: Review route, pickup window and delivery day.

observations.title: Low garment utilisation at NorthStar Västerås
observations.finding: NorthStar Västerås uses 81% of its allocated garments against a peer median of 84% (z = -2.6).
observations.action: Right-size the allocation and size mix.

observations.title: High repair intensity at NorthStar Kraków
observations.finding: NorthStar Kraków needs 202.3 repairs per 100 wearers against a peer median of 145.6 (z = 1.9).

observations.title: Recycling gap between laundries: Vistula Warsaw WWS is lowest
observations.finding: Vistula Warsaw WWS recycles 64% of textile waste against 82% at Aurora Helsinki WWS, a gap of 18 percentage points.
observations.action: Ask for the laundry roadmap and agree a joint recycling KPI.

observations.title: Laundry volume data needs confirmation
observations.finding: Data from Nordic Malmö WWS carries a consistency warning, so allocated water, energy, CO2e and waste figures for this account are less certain.
observations.action: Ask Lindström to confirm the laundry volume data before using the figures externally.

narrative.exec_summary:
In 2025, Lindström served 9,607 wearers across 24 sites in Finland, Poland, Sweden. 98.3% of service cycles were on time, and 15,233 garment repairs kept textiles in use.

Compared with Outsourced local laundry, the circular service is estimated to have avoided 1,407 m³ of water and 255 t CO₂e (206 t CO₂e to 304 t CO₂e) in washing and logistics (estimate).

The biggest improvement levers for next year are High washing intensity at NorthStar Kraków and High service-request rate at NorthStar Gdańsk.

Wearers are de-duplicated as the maximum across products per site-month and summed over sites (T2).
Laundry L003 reports far less washed kg than the customer kg routed to it, so allocation per kg is shown with a data warning.

story.title: What the service delivered
story.statement: Compared with outsourced local laundry, the Lindström service saved about 1,407 m³ (between 691 m³ and 2,122 m³) of water and about 255 t CO₂e (between 206 t CO₂e and 304 t CO₂e) in 2025.
story.relatable: ≈ 14 Finnish households' yearly water use and ≈ the yearly CO₂ emissions of 130 average Finnish passenger cars (illustrative comparison)
story.what_to_say: These are estimates against an agreed baseline, shown with a range. Ask whether the baseline matches how you would otherwise do this.

story.title: Service versus doing it yourself
story.statement: Doing the same yourself would cost about €1.96M (between €1.36M and €2.74M) in 2025. It also frees about 1,152 h (between 576 h and 2,304 h) of your staff's time.
story.what_to_say: The inputs behind this comparison are shown on the page; check that they match your own prices.

story.title: Your biggest opportunity to improve
story.statement: NorthStar Kraków washes 67 kg per wearer, more than your other sites (typically about 48.8 kg). Reviewing how often garments are changed there could cut cost and water.
story.what_to_say: Shall we look at change frequency at NorthStar Kraków together? Hygiene needs come first.
